Package io.jans.lock.trace.crypto

package io.jans.lock.trace.crypto
  • Class
    Description
    StrictBase64Url
    Strict base64url (RFC 4648 §5) codec without padding, as required by JWK x members (RFC 7517 / RFC 8037) and JWS signatures (RFC 7515 §2, "Base64url Encoding").
    TraceCryptoException
    Thrown by the TRACE crypto layer when a key cannot be built from a JWK or when the security provider cannot perform Ed25519 operations.
    TraceCryptoImpl
    Selects a TraceCryptoProvider implementation.
    TraceCryptoImpl.Literal
    Annotation literal for programmatic lookup.
    TraceCryptoProvider
    The crypto operations of TRACE ingestion: canonicalization, key parsing, signature verification with content digest, and receipt hashing.
    TraceCryptoProviderType
    Which TraceCryptoProvider implementation handles TRACE signature verification, canonicalization and receipt hashing.
    TraceHashes
    Provider-neutral hash constants and helpers shared by every TraceCryptoProvider implementation and by the service.
    TraceSignedRecord
    A parsed signed TRACE record handed to TraceCryptoProvider.verifyAndDigest(io.jans.lock.trace.crypto.TraceSignedRecord, byte[], io.jans.lock.trace.crypto.TraceVerificationKey): the exact text received, its parsed root object and the two identifiers needed to select the verification key.
    TraceTime
    Renders and parses the TRACE receipt timestamp (design §9): an RFC 3339 UTC string with exactly three fractional digits and a Z suffix, for example 2026-06-11T00:41:02.123Z.
    TraceVerificationKey
    A verification key built by TraceCryptoProvider.parseKey(java.util.Map).
